Python (pandas) implementation
- Loads FBL3N.csv
- Derives month/year components and flags exceptions where Document Date month-year > Posting Date month-year
- Filters to flagged line items
- Outputs a single CSV with the approved columns

Code:
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Paths
input_path = "data/uploads/342c2eb3-98bb-4f82-ab85-9bc2e3a5a060/FBL3N.csv"
output_dir = "output"
output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "expenses_docdate_vs_postingdate_exceptions.csv")
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load
df = pd.read_csv(input_path, dtype=str)

# Date parts (assume dates are ready for direct comparison)
doc_dt = pd.to_datetime(df["Document Date"], errors="coerce", dayfirst=True)
post_dt = pd.to_datetime(df["Posting Date"], errors="coerce", dayfirst=True)

# Derived components
doc_year = doc_dt.dt.year
doc_month = doc_dt.dt.month
doc_quarter = doc_dt.dt.quarter
post_year = post_dt.dt.year
post_month = post_dt.dt.month
post_quarter = post_dt.dt.quarter

doc_monthyear = doc_dt.dt.to_period("M").astype(str)
post_monthyear = post_dt.dt.to_period("M").astype(str)

month_diff = (doc_year * 12 + doc_month) - (post_year * 12 + post_month)
cross_quarter_flag = (doc_year == post_year) & (doc_quarter > post_quarter)
cross_year_flag = doc_year > post_year

exception_flag = month_diff > 0
exception_reason = np.where(exception_flag, "Document month-year later than Posting month-year", "")

# Attach derived columns
df["Doc_MonthYear"] = doc_monthyear
df["Post_MonthYear"] = post_monthyear
df["Month_Diff"] = month_diff
df["Cross_Quarter_Flag"] = cross_quarter_flag
df["Cross_Year_Flag"] = cross_year_flag
df["Exception_Flag"] = exception_flag
df["Exception_Reason"] = exception_reason

# Filter to exceptions
exc = df[df["Exception_Flag"] == True].copy()

# Select and order output columns (as approved)
final_cols = [
    # Identification
    "Company Code",
    "Document Number",
    # Business logic dates
    "Document Date",
    "Posting Date",
    # Context
    "G/L Account",
    "G/L Acct Long Text.1",
    "Amount in local currency",
    "Local Currency",
    "Amount in doc. curr.",
    "Document currency",
    "Document Type",
    "Posting Key",
    "Cost Center",
    "Profit Center",
    "Text",
    "Document Header Text",
    "Reference",
    "Assignment",
    "Offsett.account type",
    "Offsetting acct no.",
    "Entry Date",
    "User Name",
    "Year/month",
    # Calculated
    "Doc_MonthYear",
    "Post_MonthYear",
    "Month_Diff",
    "Cross_Quarter_Flag",
    "Cross_Year_Flag",
    "Exception_Flag",
    "Exception_Reason",
]

# Keep only columns that exist (in case of source variations)
final_cols_existing = [c for c in final_cols if c in exc.columns]

# Sort (suggested): Company Code, Post_MonthYear, Month_Diff desc
exc = exc.sort_values(by=["Company Code", "Post_MonthYear", "Month_Diff"], ascending=[True, True, False])

# Write output
exc.to_csv(output_path, index=False, columns=final_cols_existing)

print(f"Exceptions exported to: {output_path}")
